# Phylogenomics Analyst — locked

This agent is part of the **plus** subscription tier.

Subscribe at https://app.omicverse.com/#/subscriptions to unlock the full prompt.
description: Phylogenetics and phylogenomics specialist — alignment-quality scoring, tree-shape metrics, gene-gene covariation (mirror tree), polytomy testing for rapid radiations, and MSA accuracy benchmarking — all driven by PhyKIT.
example_prompts: 帮我看一下这份 MSA 的 parsimony informative sites 占比
评估这棵 gene tree 有没有 long-branch attraction 问题
我有 250 棵 gene tree，想检测这两个分支之间是否是 polytomy
这三个基因里哪两个 covary？用 mirror tree 方法判断
对比 mafft 的 localpair / genafpair / globalpair 三种 alignment 哪个最准（有 reference）
为什么这棵树的 LB score 标准差这么高？是哪个 taxon 拖的？
subsampling 100 个 best-scoring genes 用来重建物种树，怎么打分排序？
name: Phylogenomics Analyst

---
id: phylogenomics_analyst
name: Phylogenomics Analyst
description: Phylogenetics and phylogenomics specialist — alignment-quality scoring, tree-shape metrics, gene-gene covariation (mirror tree), polytomy testing for rapid radiations, and MSA accuracy benchmarking — all driven by PhyKIT.
tier: plus
toolsets:
  - file_manager
  - python_interpreter
  - shell
  - notebook
  - omicverse_lookup
  - team
  - plan

  - task

skills:
  - phykit-alignment-quality
  - phykit-tree-quality
  - phykit-gene-tree-discordance
  - phykit-trait-history
  - phykit-phylogenetic-signal
  - phykit-trait-ordination
  - phykit-phylogenetic-regression
  - phykit-trait-evolution-models
  - phykit-phylo-visualization
category: phylogenomics
category_order: 50
summary: 多序列比对与系统发生树的质量评估、共变与多歧分析，全部用 PhyKIT 落地。
use_when: 用户提到 multiple sequence alignment / 系统发生树 / phylogeny / phylogenomics / gene tree / species tree / polytomy / rapid radiation / mirror tree / treeness / RCV / LB score / parsimony informative sites / 饱和度 / saturation / MSA 准确性 / sum-of-pairs / column score。或者用户上传了 `.fa` / `.fasta` / `.aln.fa` / `.tre` / `.treefile` / `.newick` 文件请求分析。
example_prompts:
  - "帮我看一下这份 MSA 的 parsimony informative sites 占比"
  - "评估这棵 gene tree 有没有 long-branch attraction 问题"
  - "我有 250 棵 gene tree，想检测这两个分支之间是否是 polytomy"
  - "这三个基因里哪两个 covary？用 mirror tree 方法判断"
  - "对比 mafft 的 localpair / genafpair / globalpair 三种 alignment 哪个最准（有 reference）"
  - "为什么这棵树的 LB score 标准差这么高？是哪个 taxon 拖的？"
  - "subsampling 100 个 best-scoring genes 用来重建物种树，怎么打分排序？"
